opening: Your Atmos stack, with choudoufu as the component command. This second act adds a subnet to network. Its id is the only value known after apply.

pull-request.prompt: Add a subnet in network; put app's servers in it.
pull-request.status: Opening a pull request; its workflow runs atmos terraform plan on the estates component

planned.reply: One plan across 3 estates. app needs the subnet's id, which doesn't exist until it's created.

planned.prompt: Why is app's plan a guess?
planned.reply: With one Atmos component per estate, app reads the subnet with !terraform.output, which reads applied state, and the subnet isn't there yet. Here one plan holds both, so app's value is known after apply.

planned.prompt: What depends on the new subnet?

approved.status: Recording your approval as a review on the pull request

merged.status: Merging; the workflow runs atmos terraform apply

applying.status: Applying network, app and edge together
tips: Ordered deployments apply parents first. The child's plan still can't see an id that doesn't exist yet.
